title: A static-matched isotope-laminate flip gives conditional spectral substitution and explicit target-response limits
reported_status: Preserved producer claims and separate internally derived results. Source claims, internally derived proofs and same-team criticism remain unreviewed externally. Historical novelty, external mathematical correctness and physical capability are UNKNOWN. Exact algebra, producer replay, source hashes and validators establish only their specified scope. No civilisation-changing breakthrough is established.
scientific_scope_status: Proposed passive h10BN/h11BN laminate reversal with identical caps and a declared linear-plate/mass-only dielectric reference. Static mechanical moments and ideal electrostatic reflection are matched while the surface spectrum changes. Actual isotope tensors,film interfaces,target loading and the target many-body response require qualification. Vacuum-reference optical contrast is neither a superconductivity prediction nor an acquired physical capability.
